The conceptual part boundary is Books I-X versus XI-XXII; the physical-volume boundary is Books I-XIII versus XIV-XXII. They are not conflated.

readme:
# City of God source packet — {EDITION}

This is a deterministic, six-member, explicitly nonaccepted reconstruction candidate. It is not canonical and is not authorized for publication.

The package binds a clean 46-member Standard Ebooks checkout (58,815 observations), the complete CCEL npnf102 acquisition (88,276 observations, including explicit outside-City evidence-only disposition), and all 15 retained print members through a contiguous 65,536-byte chunk inventory. It preserves 22 books, 661 ordinary chapters, four book prefaces, 665 aligned units, edition-specific physical-volume and conceptual-part identities, notes, pages, inline and language carriers, continued and repeated-text evidence, 1,533 lexical and 2,390 orthographic review variants, five print decisions, 14 crop-evidence records, and known semantic defects.

Dods 1871 and NPNF 1887 remain separate witnesses. The work-date range 413-426, CCEL's 1890 printSourceInfo, and undated Eerdmans/T. & T. Clark title matter remain unresolved. The underlying historical material is treated as United States public-domain source evidence; jurisdiction can differ. Standard Ebooks contributor work is CC0, which does not alter underlying rights. CCEL labels its transcription Public Domain and the local record permits parsing. None of these statements is worldwide clearance or publication authorization.
